Compute Ranked Probability Score for ordered outcomes

Source: R/models_eval.R
rps_1x2.Rd

Better than Brier for ordered categories (H > D > A is ordered by goal difference).

Usage

rps_1x2(prob_h, prob_d, prob_a, actual)

Arguments

prob_h

Numeric vector.

prob_d

Numeric vector.

prob_a

Numeric vector.

actual

Character vector ("H", "D", or "A").

Value

Numeric. Mean RPS (lower is better).
